posts.author: Adam McCalvy
posts.text: Fun fact: The state fruit of Wisconsin is the cranberry, and some of the approximately 250 growers statewide came together to show the Brewers who they are rooting for in the World Series. (Thanks, Wisconsin State Cranberry Growers Association!)
posts.jp: 豆知識:ウィスコンシン州の州の果物はクランベリー。州内約250の生産者の一部が集まり、ワールドシリーズでどちらを応援しているかをブリュワーズに示した。(Wisconsin State Cranberry Growers Associationに感謝!)

posts.author: Adam McCalvy
posts.text: Bob Uecker’s family has issued a statement about the Brewers’ run to the World Series. “Some moments are worth waiting for,” it begins.
posts.jp: Bob Ueckerの家族が、ブリュワーズのワールドシリーズ進出について声明を発表。冒頭は「待つ価値のある瞬間がある」。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: Maryland football parts ways with coach Michael Locksley. When he was hired, Locksley called Maryland a “dream job.” The dream never materialized into a winning culture. www.thebanner.com/sports/colle...
posts.jp: メリーランド大のフットボール部が、Michael Locksley監督と契約を解消。就任時、同監督は同大を「夢の仕事」と呼んだが、勝てる文化は根付かなかった。

posts.author: Jen McCaffrey
posts.text: Some news on Red Sox coaching changes: www.nytimes.com/athletic/771...

reply_texts.text: Just read that piece, sounds like Chris Sale is still looking for a spark with the team, hope the coaching shakeup helps bring some much-needed energy to the rotation
reply_texts.author: churchandbaseball.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: I wonder how much say Tracy will have in filling the spots that are now open.
reply_texts.author: finleycordain.bsky.social

posts.jp: レッドソックスのコーチ陣の変更について、新たな情報。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: From @sararuberg.bsky.social: Student journalists were talking to UMD athletes. Then police showed up. www.thebanner.com/education/hi...
posts.jp: @sararuberg.bsky.social 発:学生記者がメリーランド大の運動部の選手に話を聞いていたところ、警察が現れた。

posts.author: Chandler Rome
posts.text: The Astros are hiring Clayton Thompson as an assistant director of player development, source tells @theathletic.com. Thompson, a former Driveline employee, worked in the Dodgers organization for the past three years, most recently as their coordinator of integrated performance.
posts.jp: アストロズが、Clayton Thompson氏を選手育成の副ディレクターとして採用へ。@theathletic.com に関係者が明かした。元Driveline職員で、過去3年はドジャース傘下に在籍し、直近は統合パフォーマンス担当コーディネーターを務めた。

posts.author: Chandler Rome
posts.text: From yesterday, an update on the Astros' GM search, with five known candidates - www.nytimes.com/athletic/770...
posts.jp: 昨日の続報。アストロズのGM探しで、判明している候補は5人。

posts.author: Tim Healey
posts.text: Updated story with @alexspeier.bsky.social: The Red Sox are keeping Jose David Flores as Chad Tracy’s bench coach. More: www.bostonglobe.com/2026/10/21/s...
posts.jp: @alexspeier.bsky.social との更新記事:レッドソックスは、Chad Tracy監督のベンチコーチとして、Jose David Floresを留任させる。
